disclaimer: ADVISORY ONLY: All diagnostic causes, forward impacts, and suggested remedial actions are advisory decision support recommendations. Final operational and isolation decisions must be taken by qualified BWSSB mechanical and electrical engineers.

CURRENT_OUTSIDE_BAND.name: Phase Current Divergence from Learned Steady-State Band
likely_causes: Hydraulic load shift due to pipe throttling or branch valve closure
Winding degradation or stator insulation resistance breakdown
Mechanical binding or bearing clearance wear in pump drive end
Fluctuation in fluid specific gravity or sediment ingestion from reservoir floor
forward_consequences: Elevated I2R stator winding resistive heating exceeding thermal class F limits
Accelerated motor insulation breakdown leading to inter-turn short circuit
Premature tripping of thermal overload relay (TOR) causing sudden supply interruption
Higher specific energy consumption and financial surcharge from power utility (BESCOM)
suggested_actions: Verify motor surface temperature using calibrated infrared thermography gun
Inspect discharge pressure and confirm delivery valve position matches SCADA setpoint
Conduct Megger insulation resistance test (> 100 Megaohms @ 2.5 kV DC)
If current exceeds +15% for > 15 minutes, prepare load shift to Standby Pump Unit 03

POWER_OUTSIDE_BAND.name: Active Power Draw Divergence from Learned Steady-State Band
likely_causes: Unscheduled pump speed variation or VFD frequency fluctuation
Impeller shroud fouling or accumulation of fibrous debris
Operating point drift along system head curve away from Best Efficiency Point (BEP)
Supply voltage depression requiring higher current draw for constant shaft torque
forward_consequences: Higher daily energy expenditure for pumping transmission corridor
Increased thermal dissipation within pump station motor control center (MCC)
Potential contract maximum demand (MD) penalty from electrical utility
Premature mechanical seal degradation due to shaft deflection
suggested_actions: Cross-check active power against suction head and discharge pressure transmitters
Verify power factor correction capacitor bank is online and functional
Inspect shaft vibration levels across drive-end and non-drive-end bearing housings
Audit SCADA flow meter readings to recompute instantaneous hydraulic efficiency

RISING_TREND_DRIFT.name: Steady-State Drift / Progressive Power Degradation
likely_causes: Progressive bearing wear and lubrication grease breakdown
Internal wear ring clearance expansion causing internal recirculation leakage
Silt/grit abrasion on bronze impeller vanes eroding hydraulic profile
Motor coupling misalignment developing mechanical reaction forces
forward_consequences: Progressive loss of volumetric discharge efficiency over weeks
Unplanned catastrophic bearing seizure causing emergency pump trip
Depletion of terminal service reservoir (High Grounds / Mount Joy) storage
Compounded lifetime energy waste exceeding replacement wear ring costs
suggested_actions: Schedule non-destructive vibration spectrum analysis (FFT) on pump and motor bearings
Grease bearing housings with manufacturer-approved high-temperature lithium complex grease
Inspect alignment using dual laser alignment tool during scheduled maintenance window
Review forecast 'Time to Alarm Limit' to schedule planned overhaul before critical threshold

VOLTAGE_IMBALANCE.name: Three-Phase Supply Voltage Imbalance (> 2.0%)
likely_causes: BESCOM 66kV/11kV substation single-phase feeder load asymmetry
High-resistance contact or pitting on Medium Voltage circuit breaker contacts
Blown transformer primary fuse or unbalanced tap-changer setting
Loose terminal termination in Motor Control Center (MCC) incoming cubicle
forward_consequences: Severe negative-sequence current injection producing counter-rotating magnetic flux
Rotor bar heating rising by 2x the square of voltage imbalance percentage (NEMA MG-1)
Thermal tripping of motor winding RTDs despite moderate active power
Severe motor life reduction: 3.5% imbalance halves motor winding lifespan
suggested_actions: Check incoming line-to-line voltages (V_RY, V_YB, V_BR) at station main incomer
Notify BESCOM load dispatch center regarding supply phase asymmetry on Tataguni 66kV bay
Perform thermal imaging of breaker busbar terminals and disconnect switches
Derate pump continuous load or de-energize if voltage imbalance exceeds 3.0%

UNDERVOLTAGE.name: Supply Undervoltage (< 90% of Rated Voltage)
likely_causes: Grid peak load depression on transmission substation
On-load tap changer (OLTC) stuck at low tap step
Excessive voltage drop across long incoming underground 11kV cables
forward_consequences: Motor pulls proportional higher current to deliver rated shaft torque ($I \propto 1/V$)
Rapid winding temperature rise triggering stator thermal protection
Reduced breakdown stall torque increasing vulnerability to transient grid dips
suggested_actions: Verify OLTC automated regulation at station 66/6.6kV power transformer
If undervoltage persists below 88%, sequentially trip non-critical booster pumps
Coordinate with Karnataka Power Transmission Corporation Limited (KPTCL) dispatch

OVERVOLTAGE.name: Supply Overvoltage (> 110% of Rated Voltage)
likely_causes: Ferranti effect during light night-time grid loading (01:00 - 04:00 AM)
Improper fixed capacitor bank overcompensation without reactive power control
forward_consequences: Magnetic core saturation in motor stator laminations
Excessive magnetizing current and increased core eddy-current iron losses
High voltage stress on motor insulation and VFD DC-bus filter capacitors
suggested_actions: Disengage automatic capacitor banks step-by-step during nocturnal light-load period
Verify transformer secondary tap position
Monitor motor core temperature via embedded resistance temperature detectors (RTDs)

LOW_POWER_FACTOR.name: Low Operating Power Factor (< 0.82)
likely_causes: Pump operating severely under-loaded (throttled discharge or low system head)
Degraded or disconnected Automatic Power Factor Correction (APFC) capacitor bank
Oversized motor installed for current operational duty point
forward_consequences: Substantial reactive power (kVAR) consumption from grid
Direct monetary penalty billed on monthly BESCOM commercial electricity tariff
Increased apparent kVA loading on substation power transformer
suggested_actions: Inspect APFC capacitor panel for blown fuse links or defective vacuum contactors
Verify current transformers (CT) feedback signal to reactive power controller
Evaluate pump throttling; open bypass or adjust VFD speed to restore optimal loading

FREQUENT_STARTS.name: Excessive Start-Stop Cycling (> 3 Starts/Hour)
likely_causes: Hunting between level sensor cut-in and cut-out thresholds in service reservoir
Pressure switch chattering due to lack of surge anticipation valve or hydraulic shock
Erroneous SCADA auto-restart loop triggered on transient sensor glitches
forward_consequences: Severe cumulative thermal stress from repeated inrush current (6x rated)
Rotor bar fatigue and brazing joint fracture from electromagnetic start forces
Premature failure of Medium Voltage vacuum circuit breaker closing mechanisms
suggested_actions: Enforce minimum run-time (15 minutes) and anti-recycle lock-out timer (20 minutes)
Widen deadband between reservoir start and stop setpoints in SCADA
Inspect air vessel cushioning and non-return valve slam prevention damping

RUNNING_DRY.name: Pump Running Dry / Suction Starvation (Low Current with Zero/Low Flow)
likely_causes: Clearwater reservoir level dropped below suction sump bellmouth intake
Air entrapment or vortex formation at pump suction manifold
Suction isolation butterfly valve closed or stuck shut
Severe suction strainer blockage with leaves, plastic, or debris
forward_consequences: Complete loss of water lubrication for internal cutless rubber / bronze sleeve bearings
Catastrophic overheating of mechanical seal faces within 60 to 90 seconds
Impeller seizure against stationary casing wear rings leading to locked rotor trip
Zero delivery to transmission main causing immediate pressure collapse downstream
suggested_actions: IMMEDIATE ACTION: Manually initiate controlled pump trip to prevent mechanical destruction
Verify suction sump water level and low-level safety interlock float switch
Inspect suction strainer basket differential pressure
Prime pump casing and vent air from casing high-point bleed valves before restart

BLOCKAGE_OR_FRICTION.name: Discharge Blockage or High Mechanical Friction (High Current with Low Flow)
likely_causes: Discharge non-return valve (NRV) or motorised butterfly valve stuck partially closed
Foreign object / timber / debris lodged between impeller shroud and casing volute
Foreign material packing in stuffing box gland seal or bearing mechanical binding
Air pocket accumulation causing hydraulic vapor lock downstream
forward_consequences: Pump operating at shut-off head churn; all shaft energy converts to fluid heat
Water inside casing rapidly reaches boiling temperature, causing cavitation and steam lock
Excessive radial hydraulic thrust causing severe shaft deflection and fatigue fracture
Motor thermal overload trip within 3 to 8 minutes
suggested_actions: Inspect motorized delivery valve actuator and limit switch feedback
Examine non-return valve counterweight lever to confirm flap has opened fully
Measure pump casing temperature; if hot to touch, stop pump immediately and allow cooling
Conduct manual bar-over of pump shaft with power locked out to detect mechanical tight spots

EFFICIENCY_DROP.name: Hydraulic Efficiency Degradation (Rising kWh per m³)
likely_causes: Gradual wear of impeller vanes and enlargement of casing ring running clearances
Roughness buildup and tuberculation inside pump volute casting
Mismatch between current pipeline system curve and pump impeller design trimming
forward_consequences: Higher electrical energy consumed per million litres delivered (kWh/ML)
Daily operational energy cost penalty compounding to lakhs of rupees annually
Increased carbon footprint for BWSSB bulk water transmission system
suggested_actions: Perform thermodynamic or calibrated wire-to-water efficiency test
Compare head-flow performance against OEM factory pump test curve
Plan pump refurbishment: replace wear rings, apply ceramic epoxy anti-friction coating
Evaluate variable frequency drive (VFD) retrofit if system operating head varies widely
